module

public import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Smallest prime $\equiv 1 \pmod n$

$$a(n) = \min \{p \in \mathbb{P} \mid p \equiv 1 \pmod n\}$$

*References:*
- [A034694](https://oeis.org/A034694)-/

@[expose] public section

namespace OeisA34694

/-- Smallest prime $\equiv 1 \pmod n$. -/
noncomputable def a (n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  sInf {p : ℕ | Nat.Prime p ∧ n ∣ (p - 1)}

/-- Value of the sequence `a` at 1. -/
@[category test, AMS 11]
theorem a_1 : a 1 = 2 := IsLeast.csInf_eq <| by decide

/-- Value of the sequence `a` at 2. -/
@[category test, AMS 11]
theorem a_2 : a 2 = 3 := IsLeast.csInf_eq <| by decide

/-- Value of the sequence `a` at 3. -/
@[category test, AMS 11]
theorem a_3 : a 3 = 7 := IsLeast.csInf_eq <| by decide

/-- Value of the sequence `a` at 4. -/
@[category test, AMS 11]
theorem a_4 : a 4 = 5 := IsLeast.csInf_eq <| by decide

/-- Value of the sequence `a` at 5. -/
@[category test, AMS 11]
theorem a_5 : a 5 = 11 := IsLeast.csInf_eq <| by decide

/--
"Conjecture: $a(n) < n^2$ for $n > 1$. - _Thomas Ordowski_, Dec 19 2016"-/
@[category research open, AMS 11]
theorem conjecture (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 < n) : a n < n ^ 2 := by
  sorry

end OeisA34694

review.notes: Checked all seven declarations; no misformalizations found. OEIS revision 76 (Aug 18, 2026), read through its official data mirror because the main page was Cloudflare-blocked, gives the same definition, initial values, and exact conjecture: “a(n) < n^2 for n > 1.” It still records this as a conjecture. Scratch proofs in /workspace/review/scratch.lean establish, without sorry, that the divisibility condition is equivalent to the intended congruence on primes, that the defining set is nonempty for every positive modulus, and that a n is its least element. The extension a 0 = 0 is outside OEIS’s domain and the conjecture’s hypothesis, so the empty-set default causes no defect. The five stated values match OEIS; additional exact-value proofs and small-input computations also passed.
